learning_objective: 🎯 To uncover the invisible pulling power of magnets, play with their poles, and discover the magic of magnetic materials!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A magnet is a special piece of metal or rock that has an invisible pulling force. It can pull certain other metals towards it without even touching them!
Magnets are picky! They only attract materials made of iron, nickel, or cobalt. Things like wood, plastic, and paper are non-magnetic, so a magnet will ignore them.

Every magnet has two ends called poles: a North Pole and a South Pole. If you bring two different poles together, they pull (attract), but if you bring two same poles together, they push away (repel)!

fun_activity.title: 🕵️‍♂️ The Magnet Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Take a small fridge magnet and walk around your house. Test 5 different objects (like a spoon, a pencil, or a coin) to see if they stick, and list the magnetic ones!

quick_recap: ⭐ Magnets have an invisible force field that attracts certain metals like iron.
⭐ Materials that do not stick to magnets are called non-magnetic.
⭐ Opposite magnetic poles attract each other, while like poles repel each other.
